title: New Jersey Gov. Sherrill calls on her lieutenant governor to resign - The Washington Post
description: An investigation found that Dale Caldwell sexually harassed a woman and violated state ethics rules. He has denied allegations of misconduct, and Sherrill said Caldwell had until Friday to step down.

title: CNN, MS NOW White House reporters denied access to Xi’s state dinner arrival - CNN
description: The White House on Thursday denied two CNN journalists from covering Chinese leader Xi Jinping’s arrival back at the White House for a state dinner, after trying to tell the network which type of journalists could cover the event.
